Subject: Renewal & capacity increase — procurement onboarding

Hi Ben / Marissa,

Following up on our renewal planning call — Helix is planning to increase committed capacity and extend the term from 12 -> 18 months starting 2028-06-01. Procurement asked me to kick off vendor onboarding and share the renewal scope so we can get PO and provisioning lined up.

Attached: Helix_Renewal_Summary.pdf (quick summary of requested SKUs and target go-live).

Could you confirm:
- The preferred PO recipient name and billing address for Redwood?
- Whether you need an updated SOW or an amendment for the term change?
- If you require a new vendor onboarding package in ProcureFlow (we can fill their portal) — any special fields for Redwood?

We need to get PO to our finance team by 2028-05-24 to hit the 6/1 uplift. Happy to jump on 30 min if that helps.

Thanks,
Emma Garcia

emma@helixcloud.com

Emma — thanks for the note and the summary. We can support the 18-month term and priority capacity uplift. High level next steps from our side:

- I'll attach our baseline SOW for a term amendment; Legal typically accepts an addendum for term changes (attached: Redwood_SOW_v1.pdf).
- Please complete ProcureFlow vendor onboarding and include Helix's billing contact + PO template; if you prefer, we can initiate the vendor invite from our side.
- Grace (Finance) will need the PO and vendor W-9 / tax info to process the change.

Quick checklist to hit 6/1:
1) Helix submits vendor onboarding form in ProcureFlow (link below).
2) Redwood Finance issues PO acceptance and account coding.
3) Legal signs term amendment (we try to keep to a 2-3 business day turnaround).
4) Provisioning schedules capacity in the Dedicated pool.

Proposed times to sync (30m): 2028-05-19 10:00 PT or 2028-05-19 15:00 PT — which works?

I attached a one-page checklist for procurement: vendor-onboard-checklist.xlsx.

Ben / Grace — looping in as discussed. Emma, thanks for the update. To keep this from slipping, here's an approval staircase we typically follow for renewals with capacity add-ons:

1) Finance: quick review of PO and account coding (Grace)
2) Legal: review and sign term amendment (I can shepherd Legal, low-touch for term-only changes)
3) Ops/Provisioning: create schedule and hold a canary window for the uplift

Action items for Helix:
- Please make sure the ProcureFlow entry includes the Helix billing contact and the W-9.
- Attach SOC 2 or upload the Redwood evidence pack to the portal (I can provide the link).
- If Helix needs an earlier go-live, Grace can provision a short-term bridge invoice while Legal finishes the addendum (requires Finance approval).

Links:
- ProcureFlow onboarding: https://procureflow.example.com/vendor/onboard/HLX-67891
- Redwood evidence pack (internal): https://redwood-internal.example.com/docs/soc2-evidence (Emma: I'll share a portal upload link if you prefer).

Attachment: approval-matrix.png

Grace — can you confirm whether Finance is comfortable issuing a provisional acceptance while Legal finalizes the amendment? If so, please indicate account code to use and whether a bridge invoice is acceptable.
